Authors: Hongyu Wang, Jingquan Wang, Bocheng Zou, Radu Serban, Dan Negrut

Causal Forcing++: Scalable Few-Step Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation WorldModel

autoregressive diffusion distillation causal consistency distillation video generation world model real-time

简要说明：提出了 Causal Forcing++，一种用于实时、少步自回归视频生成的可扩展蒸馏方法，并扩展到动作条件世界模型生成。

TLDR: Proposes Causal Forcing++, a scalable distillation method for real-time, few-step autoregressive video generation, extending to action-conditioned world models.

Abstract: Real-time interactive video generation requires low-latency, streaming, and controllable rollout. Existing autoregressive (AR) diffusion distillation methods have achieved strong results in the chunk-wise 4-step regime by distilling bidirectional base models into few-step AR students, but they remain limited by coarse response granularity and non-negligible sampling latency. In this paper, we study a more aggressive setting: frame-wise autoregression with only 1--2 sampling steps. In this regime, we identify the initialization of a few-step AR student as the key bottleneck: existing strategies are either target-misaligned, incapable of few-step generation, or too costly to scale. We propose \textbf{Causal Forcing++}, a principled and scalable pipeline that uses \emph{causal consistency distillation} (causal CD) for few-step AR initialization. The core idea is that causal CD learns the same AR-conditional flow map as causal ODE distillation, but obtains supervision from a single online teacher ODE step between adjacent timesteps, avoiding the need to precompute and store full PF-ODE trajectories. This makes the initialization both more efficient and easier to optimize. The resulting pipeline, \ours, surpasses the SOTA 4-step chunk-wise Causal Forcing under the \textit{\textbf{frame-wise 2-step setting}} by 0.1 in VBench Total, 0.3 in VBench Quality, and 0.335 in VisionReward, while reducing first-frame latency by 50\% and Stage 2 training cost by $\sim$$4\times$. We further extend the pipeline to action-conditioned world model generation in the spirit of Genie3. Project Page: https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing and https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM .

摘要（中文）：实时交互式视频生成需要具备低延迟、流式传输和可控推演能力。现有的自回归扩散蒸馏方法通过将双向基础模型蒸馏为少步数自回归学生模型，在分块式4步采样机制中取得了显著成果，但其仍受限于响应粒度粗糙和不可忽略的采样延迟。本文研究一种更激进的设定：仅需1-2采样步数的逐帧自回归机制。在此设定下，我们发现少步数自回归学生模型的初始化是关键瓶颈：现有策略存在目标未对齐、无法实现少步数生成或计算成本过高而难以扩展等问题。为此，我们提出**Causal Forcing++**——一种基于原则且可扩展的流程，采用**因果一致性蒸馏**进行少步数自回归模型初始化。其核心思想在于，因果一致性蒸馏学习与因果ODE蒸馏相同的自回归条件流映射，但通过相邻时间步间单次在线教师ODE步长获取监督信号，从而避免了预计算和存储完整PF-ODE轨迹的需求。这使得初始化过程兼具更高效率和更优的优化特性。所提流程在**逐帧2步采样设定**下，以VBench总分0.1分、VBench质量分0.3分、VisionReward分0.335分的优势超越当前最优的4步分块式Causal Forcing方法，同时将首帧延迟降低50%，第二阶段训练成本减少约4倍。我们进一步将该流程扩展至基于Genie3思想的动作条件世界模型生成领域。项目页面：https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing 与 https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM 。

Authors: Min Zhao, Hongzhou Zhu, Kaiwen Zheng, Zihan Zhou, Bokai Yan, Xinyuan Li, Xiao Yang, Chongxuan Li, Jun Zhu

DriveCtrl: Conditioned Sim-to-Real Driving Video Generation AutonomousDriving

sim-to-real video generation driving video synthesis depth-conditioned temporal consistency domain gap

简要说明：DriveCtrl是一个用于真实驾驶视频合成的深度条件可控的仿真到真实视频生成框架，缩小了仿真到现实的差距，同时保留了用于下游感知任务的帧级注释。

TLDR: DriveCtrl is a depth-conditioned controllable sim-to-real video generation framework for realistic driving video synthesis, narrowing the sim-to-real gap while preserving frame-level annotations for downstream perception tasks.

Abstract: Large-scale labelled driving video data is essential for training autonomous driving systems. Although simulation offers scalable and fully annotated data, the domain gap between synthetic and real-world driving videos significantly limits its utility for downstream deployment. Existing video generation methods are not well-suited for this task, as they fail to simultaneously preserve scene structure, object dynamics, temporal consistency, and visual realism, all of which are critical for maintaining annotation validity in generated data. In this paper, we present DriveCtrl, a depth-conditioned controllable sim-to-real video generation framework for realistic driving video synthesis. Built upon a pretrained video foundation model, DriveCtrl introduces a structure-aware adapter that enables depth-guided generation while preserving the scene layout and motion patterns of the source simulation, producing temporally coherent driving videos that remain aligned with the original simulated sequences. We further introduce a scalable data generation pipeline that transforms simulator videos into realistic driving footage matching the visual style of a target real-world dataset. The pipeline supports three conditioning signals: structural depth, reference-dataset style, and text prompts, while preserving frame-level annotations for downstream perception tasks. To better assess this task, we propose a driving-domain-specific knowledge-informed evaluation metric called Driving Video Realism Score (DVRS) that assesses the realism of generated videos. Experiments demonstrate that DriveCtrl consistently outperforms the base model and competing alternatives in realism, temporal quality, and perception task performance, substantially narrowing the sim-to-real gap for driving video generation.

摘要（中文）：大规模带标注的驾驶视频数据对训练自动驾驶系统至关重要。尽管仿真能够提供可扩展且全标注的数据，但合成数据与真实驾驶视频之间的领域差异显著限制了其在下游部署中的应用价值。现有视频生成方法难以同时满足场景结构保持、物体动态还原、时间连贯性及视觉真实感等关键要求，而这些因素对于生成数据中标注有效性的维持至关重要。本文提出DriveCtrl框架，这是一种基于深度条件控制、面向真实驾驶视频合成的仿真到现实视频生成方案。该框架基于预训练视频基础模型构建，通过引入结构感知适配器实现深度引导生成，在保持源仿真场景布局与运动模式的同时，生成时间连贯且与原始仿真序列对齐的驾驶视频。我们进一步设计了可扩展的数据生成流程，能够将仿真器视频转化为符合目标真实数据集视觉风格的逼真驾驶影像。该流程支持结构深度、参考数据集风格与文本提示三种控制信号，同时保持帧级标注信息以支持下游感知任务。针对该任务的评估需求，我们提出了专用于驾驶领域的知识感知评估指标——驾驶视频真实度评分（DVRS），用于量化生成视频的真实性。实验表明，DriveCtrl在真实感、时间连贯性及感知任务性能上均显著优于基础模型与竞争方法，极大缩小了驾驶视频生成领域的仿真与现实差距。

Authors: Haonan Zhao, Yiting Wang, Jingkun Chen, Valentina Donzella, Thomas Bashford-Rogers, Kurt Debattista

SOCC-ICP: Semantics-Assisted Odometry based on Occupancy Grids and ICP Perception3D

LiDAR odometry semantic occupancy grid ICP dynamic object filtering map representation

简要说明：提出了一种语义辅助的LiDAR里程计框架，联合执行语义占据栅格建图与扫描匹配，提高了鲁棒性并直接提供适用于下游机器人任务的建图结果。

TLDR: Proposes a semantics-assisted LiDAR odometry framework that jointly performs semantic occupancy grid mapping and scan alignment, improving robustness and providing a map directly usable for downstream robotics tasks.

Abstract: Reliable pose estimation in previously unseen environments is a fundamental capability of autonomous systems. Existing LiDAR odometry methods typically employ point-, surfel-, or NDT-based map representations, which are distinct from the semantic occupancy grids commonly used for downstream tasks such as motion planning. We introduce SOCC-ICP, a semantics-assisted odometry framework that jointly performs Semantic OCCupancy grid mapping and LiDAR scan alignment. Each map voxel encodes geometric and semantic statistics, enabling adaptive point-to-point or point-to-plane ICP based on local planarity. Further, the occupancy grid naturally filters dynamic objects through raycasting-based free-space updates. Across diverse evaluation scenarios, SOCC-ICP achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art LiDAR odometry and remains robust in geometrically degenerate environments, even in the absence of semantic cues. When semantic labels are available, integrating them into map construction, downsampling, and correspondence weighting yields further accuracy gains. By unifying odometry and semantic occupancy grid mapping within a single representation, SOCC-ICP eliminates redundant map structures and directly provides a map suitable for downstream robotic applications.

摘要（中文）：在未知环境中实现可靠的姿态估计是自主系统的一项基本能力。现有的激光雷达里程计方法通常采用基于点、面元或正态分布变换的地图表示方式，这与下游任务（如运动规划）中常用的语义占据栅格存在显著差异。我们提出了SOCC-ICP，一种语义辅助的里程计框架，能够同时执行语义占据栅格建图和激光雷达扫描对齐。每个地图体素均编码几何与语义统计信息，支持基于局部平面性进行自适应点对点或点对平面的ICP配准。此外，占据栅格通过基于光线投射的自由空间更新，天然实现对动态物体的过滤。在多种评估场景中，SOCC-ICP达到了与先进激光雷达里程计方法相竞争的性能，即使在缺乏语义信息的情况下，也能在几何退化环境中保持稳健性。当可获得语义标签时，将其融入地图构建、下采样及对应关系加权过程可进一步提升精度。通过将里程计与语义占据栅格建图统一于单一表示中，SOCC-ICP消除了冗余的地图结构，并直接提供了适用于下游机器人应用的地图。

Authors: Johannes Scherer, Sebastian Hirt, Henri Meeß

CaMeRL: Collision-Aware and Memory-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for UAV Navigation in Multi-Scale Obstacle Environments RLRobot

reinforcement learning UAV navigation obstacle avoidance collision-aware representation temporal memory

简要说明：提出CaMeRL，一个用于无人机导航的强化学习框架，它使用碰撞感知表示来处理小障碍物，并利用时序记忆模块处理大障碍物遮挡，从而在多尺度障碍物环境中提高性能。

TLDR: Proposes CaMeRL, a reinforcement learning framework for UAV navigation that uses a collision-aware representation for small obstacles and a temporal memory module to handle occlusions from large obstacles, improving performance in multi-scale obstacle environments.

Abstract: In obstacle avoidance navigation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), variations in obstacle scale have received strangely less attention than obstacle number or density. Existing methods typically extract purely geometric features from single-frame depth observations. Such representations tend to neglect small obstacles and lose spatial context under occlusions caused by large obstacles, leading to noticeable degradation in environments with multi-scale obstacles. To address this issue, we propose CaMeRL, a Collision-aware and Memory-enhanced Reinforcement Learning framework for UAV navigation. The collision-aware latent representation encodes risk-sensitive depth cues to preserve fine-grained obstacle structures, thereby improving sensitivity to small obstacles. The temporal memory module integrates observations across frames, mitigating partial observability caused by large-obstacle occlusions. We evaluate CaMeRL with multi-scale obstacles, including ultra-small and extra-large obstacle settings. Results show that CaMeRL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across all scales, with success rate gains of 0.48 and 0.28 in the ultra-small and extra-large settings, respectively. More importantly, CaMeRL achieves reliable navigation in cluttered outdoor environments.

摘要（中文）：在无人机避障导航中，障碍物尺度变化所受到的关注度远低于障碍物数量或密度。现有方法通常仅从单帧深度观测中提取纯几何特征，这类表征倾向于忽略小型障碍物，并在大型障碍物遮挡下丧失空间上下文信息，导致在多尺度障碍物环境中性能显著下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出CaMeRL——一种基于碰撞感知与记忆增强强化学习的无人机导航框架。该框架通过碰撞感知潜在表征对风险敏感的深度线索进行编码，以保留细粒度障碍物结构，从而提升对小尺度障碍物的感知能力；其时序记忆模块融合多帧观测信息，有效缓解大型障碍物遮挡导致的局部可观测性问题。我们在包含超小型与超大型障碍物的多尺度场景中对CaMeRL进行评估，实验结果表明：在所有尺度条件下，CaMeRL均优于当前最先进的基线方法，在超小与超大障碍物场景中成功率分别提升0.48和0.28。更重要的是，CaMeRL在杂乱户外环境中实现了可靠的自主导航。

Authors: Hong Hong, Feiyu Liao, Yongheng Liang, Boning Zhang, Haitao Wang, Hejun Wu

Distill: Uncovering the True Intent behind Human-Robot Communication Manipulation

human-robot communication task specification intent elicitation crowdsourcing study interface

简要说明：本文提出Distill方法，通过去除不必要步骤、泛化步骤含义和放宽顺序约束，从用户提供的任务规范中提炼和澄清用户的真实意图。

TLDR: The paper introduces Distill, a method for refining user-provided task specifications to better capture true intent by removing unnecessary steps, generalizing step meanings, and relaxing ordering constraints.

Abstract: As robots become increasingly integrated into everyday environments, intuitive communication paradigms such as natural language and end-user programming have become indispensable for specifying autonomous robot behavior. However, these mechanisms are ineffective at fully capturing user intent: natural language is imprecise and ambiguous, whereas end-user programming can be overly specific. As a result, understanding what users truly mean when they interact with robots remains a central challenge for human-AI communication systems. To address this issue, we propose the Distill approach for human-robot communication interfaces. Given a task specification provided by the user, Distill (1) removes unnecessary steps; (2) generalizes the meaning behind individual steps; and (3) relaxes ordering constraints between steps. We implemented Distill on a web interface and, through a crowdsourcing study, demonstrated its ability to elicit and refine user intent from initial task specifications.

摘要（中文）：随着机器人日益融入日常环境，自然语言和最终用户编程等直观交互范式已成为指定自主机器人行为不可或缺的方式。然而，这些机制往往难以完整捕捉用户意图：自然语言存在不精确和模糊性，而最终用户编程可能过于具体。因此，如何准确理解用户与机器人交互时的真实意图，仍是人机交互系统面临的核心挑战。针对这一问题，我们提出了适用于人机交互界面的Distill方法。该方法基于用户提供的任务描述，依次执行以下操作：（1）剔除冗余步骤；（2）泛化单个步骤的语义内涵；（3）弱化步骤间的顺序约束。我们通过网页界面实现了Distill系统，并借助众包研究验证了其从初始任务描述中提取并优化用户意图的能力。

Authors: Ting Li, David Porfirio

Quantitative Video World Model Evaluation for Geometric-Consistency WorldModel

video world model geometric evaluation 3D reconstruction physical plausibility generative video

简要说明：该论文提出了PDI-Bench，一个用于评估世界模型生成视频几何一致性的定量框架，通过物体分割、三维重建和投影几何残差来诊断模型故障。

TLDR: The paper introduces PDI-Bench, a quantitative framework for evaluating geometric coherence in videos generated by world models, using object segmentation, 3D lifting, and projective-geometry residuals to diagnose failures.

Abstract: Generative video models are increasingly studied as implicit world models, yet evaluating whether they produce physically plausible 3D structure and motion remains challenging. Most existing video evaluation pipelines rely heavily on human judgment or learned graders, which can be subjective and weakly diagnostic for geometric failures. We introduce PDI-Bench (Perspective Distortion Index), a quantitative framework for auditing geometric coherence in generated videos. Given a generated clip, we obtain object-centric observations via segmentation and point tracking (e.g., SAM 2, MegaSaM, and CoTracker3), lift them to 3D world-space coordinates via monocular reconstruction, and compute a set of projective-geometry residuals capturing three failure dimensions: scale-depth alignment, 3D motion consistency, and 3D structural rigidity. To support systematic evaluation, we build PDI-Dataset, covering diverse scenarios designed to stress these geometric constraints. Across state-of-the-art video generators, PDI reveals consistent geometry-specific failure modes that are not captured by common perceptual metrics, and provides a diagnostic signal for progress toward physically grounded video generation and physical world model. Our code and dataset can be found at https://pdi-bench.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：生成式视频模型作为隐式世界模型的研究日益深入，然而评估其生成的视频是否具有物理上合理的三维结构和运动仍具挑战性。现有的大多数视频评估流程严重依赖人工判断或训练出的评分器，这些方法往往主观性强，且对几何结构故障的诊断能力较弱。我们提出了PDI-Bench（透视失真指数），这是一个用于量化评估生成视频中几何连贯性的框架。给定一个生成的视频片段，我们通过分割和点追踪技术（如SAM 2、MegaSaM和CoTracker3）获取以物体为中心的观测数据，通过单目重建将其提升至三维世界坐标系，并计算一系列捕捉三维几何故障的投影几何残差，涵盖三个故障维度：尺度-深度对齐、三维运动一致性和三维结构刚性。为支持系统化评估，我们构建了PDI-Dataset，涵盖多种场景设计以检验这些几何约束。在多个先进的视频生成模型中，PDI揭示出传统感知指标无法捕捉的、与几何相关的系统性故障模式，并为朝着具备物理基础的视频生成和物理世界模型的发展提供了诊断依据。我们的代码和数据集可在https://pdi-bench.github.io/获取。

Authors: Jiaxin Wu, Yihao Pi, Yinling Zhang, Yuheng Li, Xueyan Zou

TeachAnything: A Multimodal Crowdsourcing Platform for Training Embodied AI Agents in Symmetrical Reality Other

Symmetrical Reality crowdsourcing platform multimodal demonstration physics simulation embodied agents

简要说明：提出了一个名为TeachAnything的多模态众包平台，旨在收集跨场景、任务和具身形式的各种演示数据，用于训练符合对称现实（Symmetrical Reality）的具身智能体。

TLDR: Introduces a multimodal crowdsourcing platform called TeachAnything for collecting diverse demonstration data across varied scenes, tasks, and embodiments, aimed at training embodied AI agents aligned with Symmetrical Reality.

Abstract: Symmetrical Reality (SR) is emerging as a future trend for human-agent coexistence, placing higher demands on agents to acquire human-like intelligence. It calls for richer and more diverse human guidance. We introduce a three-stage demonstration paradigm integrating multimodal demonstration signals. Building on this paradigm, we developed TeachAnything, a cloud-based, crowdsourcing-oriented demonstration platform with physics simulation capable of collecting diverse demonstration data across varied scenes, tasks, and embodiments. By unifying virtual and physical interactions through both methodological design and physics simulation, the system serves as a practical foundation for developing embodied agents aligned with Symmetrical Reality.

摘要（中文）：对称现实作为人机共存的未来趋势，正对智能体提出更高的拟人化智能要求，这需要更丰富多元的人类示教指导。我们提出了一种融合多模态示教信号的三阶段示教范式，并基于此开发了TeachAnything平台。该平台具备物理仿真能力的云端众包示教系统，能够跨场景、跨任务、跨形态收集多样化示教数据。通过方法论设计与物理仿真相结合，系统实现了虚拟与实体交互的统一，为开发符合对称现实理念的具身智能体提供了实践基础。
